fare_rules.concessions: Official provisional fares, notified 4 April 2026: large bus Rs 40 up to 10 km, Rs 70 up to 30 km, Rs 110 above that. Minibus and coach: Rs 50, Rs 80 and Rs 120 for the same distances. The notice says fares remain as they were before 27 February 2026. Route lists for private services are not published officially; help add them.

Unofficial app data; all rights reserved by Cheeltech, no licence stated (owner decided to include with attribution). One direction only. This is the Data (Daata) Coach: Mnzil shows a Chinchi icon for it, but a 23-stop Surjani - Clifton run via Tariq Road and Cantt Station is a coach alignment, and it matches the URC 2010 'Data Coach' (Surjani Town - Halipad), the Zameen Blog 2023 'Data Coach Route: KDA Site Office to Abdullah Shah Ghazi Mazar' and the Zenodo 'DATA-Coach' chain. Put in the bus file for that reason; move to karachi-chinchi if Mnzil's icon turns out to be right.
